assumptions: Let A be a complex C*-algebra, not assumed unital, H a complex Hilbert space, and ρ a representation of A on H.
conclusion: compactPreimageIdeal ρ is the two-sided algebraic ideal of elements whose represented bounded operator is compact. Norm-closedness is a separate theorem and is not a field of this returned TwoSidedIdeal.
definition_equation: (compactPreimageIdeal ρ : Set A) = {a : A | IsCompactOperator (ρ a)}.
